title: The Weather Channel Just Forecast GTA 6's Leonida: Sea Fog, Swamp Storms ⛈️ #Shorts
description:
The Weather Channel posted six in-character forecasts for Leonida, each with a new official GTA 6 screenshot (Rockstar Games via The Weather Channel, Nov 16, 2026): sea fog over South Ocean Beach in Vice City, mist in Gambit Bay, heavy rain in the Leonida Keys, a storm over Pelican Valley, rain and wind near Key Lento and a tropical storm at the Rusty Anchor. Rockstar's Owen Shepherd says the weather was reimagined to be more localized, persistent and dynamic.

Sources: The Weather Channel / Rockstar Games; GTA BOOM; GameSpot.

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
